blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Amid the continued decline in economic growth, Secretary Arsenio Balisacan has outlined five priorities to restore growth: reviving investment, accelerating infrastructure, strengthening food and energy security, creating better jobs through higher-value industries and expanding trade and investment partnerships.
